entities.name: The Murders at Karlov Manor
entities.description: Major criminal investigation on Ravnica in 4564 AR centered on assassinations of guild figures.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the Murders took place.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: Central dryad of Trostani and mastermind of the Murders.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Selesnya leader who withdrew from leadership.

entities.name: Anzrag
entities.description: Gruul god who broke loose and later escaped custody.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: Investigative agency that stopped Anzrag.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Orzhov leader who hosted the party at Karlov Manor and was assassinated, then led as a ghost.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Assassinated at the Karlov Manor party.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: Arrested as suspect and later freed by Proft.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: Took over the investigation and captured Oba.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Investigator who revealed Oba as the killer.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: Attempted to assassinate Proft but was stopped by Etrata.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: Kidnapped Kylox; targeted by Oba for profiting from the war.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: Kidnapped by Krenko and accidentally killed.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: Captured Agrus Kos in an attempt to frame Rakdos.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Captured by Judith.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Guildmaster of the Cult of Rakdos Judith tried to frame.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Selesnya tree where Proft gathered the guild leaders.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Guild of the culprit.

entities.name: Tolsimir Wolfblood
entities.description: Killed by Oba.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: Left in charge of the Selesnya after Trostani withdrew.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: Guild Teysa led as a ghost.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon whose Omenpath Project Proft offered to serve.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion preceding the crime wave.

events.summary: Anzrag breaks loose of guild control and is stopped by the Agency.
events.quote: broke loose of guild control and was stopped by the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations

events.summary: Zegana is assassinated at Teysa's party and Etrata is arrested.
events.quote: Zegana was assassinated, and Etrata was arrested as a suspect

events.summary: Teysa is assassinated; Kaya takes over the investigation and Proft frees Etrata.
events.quote: Three days later, Teysa was also assassinated.

events.summary: Massacre Girl tries to kill Proft but Etrata stops her; Krenko kidnaps Kylox, who is accidentally killed.
events.quote: Massacre Girl attempted to assassinate Proft but was stopped by Etrata

events.summary: Anzrag escapes custody and rampages through Agency headquarters; Judith captures Agrus Kos to frame Rakdos.
events.quote: Judith captured Agrus Kos in an attempt to frame Rakdos

events.summary: Proft and Kaya deduce the killers were brainwashed by pollen from plants grown through Vitu-Ghazi's roots.
events.quote: pointing to a member of the Selesnya Conclave

events.summary: Proft gathers the guild leaders and reveals Oba as the killer; Oba confesses her motives.
events.quote: revealed the killer as Oba, the central dryad of Trostani

events.summary: Oba attacks the assembly and kills Tolsimir Wolfblood but is captured by Kaya and Etrata with Teysa's ghost.
Trostani withdraws, leaving Emmara Tandris in charge; Teysa leads the Orzhov as a ghost.
events.quote: Trostani withdrew from leadership, leaving Emmara Tandris in charge

events.summary: Proft discovers Niv-Mizzet's Omenpath Project and offers his services.
events.quote: offered his services to the dragon

relations.quote: Proft and Kaya pieced together that the murders were committed by brainwashed citizens
to frame Rakdos , her own guildmaster

relations.note: targeted for experimenting with Phyrexian oil
relations.quote: Oba confessed to targeting Zegana for experimenting with Phyrexian oil
